resources.string: What this app calls their device, e.g. their first name
Add a device another parent set up
Is PhoneLock already on their phone or tablet?
Install PhoneLock on their device from this phone, over Wi-Fi. Takes about 10 minutes, and nothing on it is erased.
For a device that doesn\'t have PhoneLock yet.
Scan the pairing code from the other parent\'s app, and you\'ll both manage it.
For a device that already has PhoneLock.
The other parent opens PhoneLock, taps ⋮ on the device, then Share with another parent. It shows a QR code.
With this phone\'s camera, or paste the pairing link if they sent it to you.
Choose what this app calls the device, and how your name appears on it.
The other parent\'s phone nearby, or a pairing link from them
On the other parent\'s phone: PhoneLock > ⋮ on the device > Share with another parent.
This isn\'t a PhoneLock pairing link
This code is for a server this version of PhoneLock can\'t reach. Ask the other parent to set the device up on PhoneLock\'s own server.
Shown on their device, e.g. \"%1$s allowed Camera\"
On the other parent\'s phone, open PhoneLock, tap \"%1$s\" and scan this code.
Anyone with this code can control the device. Only show it to the other parent.
Camera access is needed to scan the pairing code.
Point at the pairing QR code

Fix setup turns PhoneLock\'s features back on for %1$s: screen view, call limits and call log, files, ringing through Do Not Disturb, and working while idle. It doesn\'t change its pairing, schedule or apps.
Their device on the same Wi-Fi as this phone
Parent mode unlocked on it (hold the clock for 4 seconds, enter the PIN), to reach Settings
Developer options turned on there: Settings > About phone, tap Build number 7 times
Same Wi-Fi, accounts removed for now, Developer options on. About 5 minutes.
The PIN unlocks parent mode on their device.
Their device shows a 6-digit code; you type it here.
Installs, connects it to this app and turns on its features. About 2 minutes.
Their phone or tablet, with Android 13 or later, charged and in your hands
Both devices on the same Wi-Fi network
To sign out of its accounts until setup is done (you add them back in parent mode)
Nothing on their device is erased.
The same network as this phone.
Settings > Passwords & accounts: remove each one (Google and others). Android only lets PhoneLock take charge of a device with no accounts. You add them back at the end.
Settings > About phone: tap Build number 7 times, until it says you\'re a developer.
Unlocks parent mode on their device
On their device: Settings > System > Developer options > Wireless debugging. Turn it on, then tap Pair device with pairing code. Keep that screen open until setup starts.
Looking for it… It appears here once its pairing code is showing.
Shown under the pairing code, e.g. 192.168.1.20:37755
Only if setup can\'t find it: the port after \"IP address & Port\" on the Wireless debugging screen
Recommended, so it can\'t be used to undo PhoneLock. Parent mode can turn it back on.
Wireless debugging is now off on their device. Add their accounts back in parent mode (hold the clock for 4 seconds).
Wireless debugging is still on on their device; turn it off in parent mode once it\'s working. Add their accounts back in parent mode (hold the clock for 4 seconds).
Keep this screen open until setup finishes.
Couldn\'t find the device\'s debugging port. Keep Wireless debugging open on it and try again.
This device runs an Android version older than 13
PhoneLock on the device didn\'t answer. Try again.
This isn\'t %1$s\'s device. Open Wireless debugging on the right one.
Already connected to this app: carrying on
Set up by another parent: checking its features only
PhoneLock is installed but wasn\'t connected: continuing from there
PhoneLock isn\'t set up on this device. Use Add a child\'s device instead.
Remove the accounts on the device first (Settings > Passwords & accounts); add them back afterwards in parent mode
Remove the device\'s other users first (Settings > System > Multiple users)
Another app already manages this device (device owner)
Left on: it\'s another parent\'s device
Left on, because the device hasn\'t answered through the internet yet
The device didn\'t confirm; debugging may still be on
It hasn\'t answered through the internet yet. Check its connection; debugging stays on until it does.
The device didn\'t accept the pairing: %1$s. Try again.
The device didn\'t accept the pairing: no answer. Try again.
The download isn\'t a genuine PhoneLock lock app
This device was already set up by another parent. Ask them to share it with you (device settings > Share with another parent).
%1$s is set up and connected to this app.
%1$s Some features couldn\'t be turned on; see above.
The device doesn\'t trust this phone (pair it again)
The device doesn\'t trust this phone yet (pair it first)
The device asked for USB-style authorization; turn on Wireless debugging and pair first
The device sent an invalid pairing message
The device stopped answering during pairing
Wrong pairing code, or it expired
Allow background use so requests arrive right away.
Allow emergency alerts to show full screen, like an incoming call.
